name: Gates Foundation
program: Gates Foundation Grand Challenges grant opportunities and RFPs
collect_note: Reads the Gates Foundation's Grand Challenges grant opportunities list twice a day and turns each opportunity on it into a call row that waits for review; the list is empty today, so a new call appears the day it is posted.

zero_reason.quote: There are no open Grant Opportunities at this time.
zero_reason.note: Page server-renders its opportunities as article cards; same markup tested on www.grandchallenges.org/grant-opportunities (1 card, Keystone Symposia, parsed with title, link and deadline). The main Gates RFP portal https://submit.gatesfoundation.org/ renders its program list by JavaScript from an API that needs login (403), so it cannot be read over plain HTTP; it is linked from https://www.gatesfoundation.org/about/how-we-work/grant-opportunities.

evidence: GET https://gcgh.grandchallenges.org/grant-opportunities HTTP 200 (Gates-run Grand Challenges site, empty list 2026-11-12); hub page with identical markup parsed into 1 item by this config; gatesfoundation.org/about/how-we-work/grant-opportunities HTTP 200 points to submit.gatesfoundation.org (SurveyMonkey Apply, list JS-only, /api/programs/ 403) and to this Grand Challenges list; no RSS/Atom (gcgh /rss.xml, /feed 404), drupal.grandchallenges.org json:agg is behind Cloudflare Access, gatesfoundation.org sitemaps hold no RFP section; endpoint_recon verdict html_ok with no opportunity endpoint.
